name: Conveno

mark.construction: Lowercase c: spine x8 y12 w12 h40; top arm x20 y12 w24 h8; bottom arm x20 y44 w24 h8 (the arms are the record's entries). Point: circle cx52 cy32 r8 (accent), sitting in the c's opening = the orchestrator / the decision. Flat cut ends, no rounding. Edges on multiples of 4 for whole pixels at 16 and 32. Known risk: at 16px it can read as '[' plus a dot; keep the aperture open and the point clearly separated.
mark.clearSpace: 1 unit (8/64 of mark height) minimum on every side; 2 units preferred

roles.entry: The one accent. The point in the mark, the orchestrator, links, primary actions, 'live'. Never used for decoration.
roles.stamp: Attention that needs the owner: open tickets, waiting on question. Not an error.
roles.ok/warn/error/info: Semantic state only. Never as brand accents.

color.accentDiscipline: Entry blue is reserved for: (1) the mark's point wherever the mark or its motif appears (logo, lockups, the c───● spinner point); (2) the orchestrator (marker, status-orchestrator, orchestrator icons); (3) the live delivery tier; (4) links; (5) focus ring. Everything else is ink/quiet/semantic: icon points default to currentColor; primary buttons, toggles, checkboxes are ink; terminal commands are bold ink; the prompt › is quiet; a handoff in transit is ink.

type.rules: Timestamps, session names, commands and ids are always mono. Labels are mono uppercase at xs with label tracking. Headings use display, sentence case.

motion.rules: Motion explains a change in the record: something written, moved, sealed or answered. No bounce, no overshoot, no ambient looping except the stoppable 'listening' idle. Respect prefers-reduced-motion by showing the end state.

spinner.name: entry-write
spinner.noMotion: Static 'c─── ●' line when CONVENO_NO_MOTION=1, CI is set, stdout is not a TTY, or NO_COLOR with TERM=dumb.

terminal.env: NO_COLOR disables colour; FORCE_COLOR=0..3 forces level; COLORTERM=truecolor|24bit enables truecolor; CONVENO_NO_MOTION and CI disable spinners.

naming.cssVariables: All CSS custom properties use the --cv- prefix (e.g. --cv-ink, --cv-ease-enter, --cv-dur-quick, --cv-fs-sm, --cv-s-4, --cv-r-md). The icon accent point colour is --cv-point.
naming.cssClasses: Components: .cv-<component>. Motion demo-only classes: .cv-m-<name> (never collide with components). Icon sprite ids: #cv-<icon-name>.
naming.iconInternals: .cv-pt (icon point, fill var(--cv-point, currentColor)) and .cv-pt-entry (point that defaults to entry) are part of the icon library.

shapes.orchestrator: small c + point (point in entry blue): the mark in miniature. The only status shape that is a c, so it reads without colour.

terminal.orchestrator: ● in entry, always followed by the label 'orchestrator' (the terminal can't draw the c)

status.rule: Icons (status-*), UI components and terminal all use these same five shapes.

showcaseRules: No eyebrow/kicker labels that repeat headings. Section structure uses the Minutes margin rule with an INK node per section. Headings (h1-h3) use the display font (Schibsted Grotesk 700/800). Buttons, toast titles, form labels and UI text use the body font (Plex Sans 500). Mono only for timestamps, names, commands, ids, code. Showcase pages may use page-local class names but must NOT use the reserved .cv- / .cv-m- prefixes for page chrome.

exempt: assets/social-preview*.svg (source for the PNG; outlined text)
